units: Targ. II Sam. XVII, 10 מִמַס יִמְסֵי (ed. Wil. יַמְסֵי Af.), v. מְסַס.—Part. מָסֵי, f. מַסְיָא.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 5:21">Targ. O. Num. V, 21</cite> (ed. Vienna <cite ref="M01914"><he>מַסְּיָא</he></cite> = <he>מְמַסְּיָא</he>, v. infra).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 39:12">Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 12</cite> <cite ref="M01914"><he>מַסְּיַת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 5:22">Targ. Y. Num. V, 22</cite> <he>למַסְיָא</he> = <he>למְמַסְיָא</he>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00052"><he>מְמַסָּא</he></cite>, <he>מְמַסֵּי</he>, f. (<he>מְ</he>)<cite ref="M01914"><he>מַסְּיָא</he></cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Pesachim 28a">Pes. 28ᵃ</cite> Rashi <he>לא מְמַסָּה</he> is not dissolved in water, v. <cite ref="M00028"><he>מְאִיס</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="M01910">same</cite>. Targ. O. Num. l. c.; a. e.—Targ. II Sam. l. c., v. supra.
